meta.data_source: PhysioNet MIT-BIH Normal Sinus Rhythm Database (nsrdb) record 16265 (32 M, 22.24 h) — PUBLIC PLACEHOLDER, NOT THE USER'S OWN DATA
meta.ap_model: O'Hara-Rudy 2011 human ventricular myocyte (ORd), endo variant, 41 states, SciPy BDF
meta.hemodynamic_model: four-chamber time-varying elastance + three-element Windkessel (systemic, pulmonary) + compressed intramyocardial coronary branch
meta.qt_definition: APD90 + 65 ms ventricular activation spread (Durrer et al. 1970, doi:10.1161/01.cir.41.6.899) -- single-cell surrogate, NOT a simulated ECG; runs short of clinical QT
meta._resampled_from: 1 ms cardiac-model export, decimated to 2 ms for the web scene
